activity: Combustion of natural gas in homes and buildings
notes: Confirmed from LFP GHG Inventory Report Table 3. Residential 18692 + commercial 2329. 22% of communitywide 2023. Largest building source; building electrification + efficiency is the key lever.

activity: Grid electricity consumed in homes and buildings
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. Residential 2501 + commercial 406. Up 177% vs 2019 — driven by a 352% rise in Seattle City Light reported carbon intensity (power-supply mix change), not consumption (which rose <1%). Still only 3% of communitywide 2023.

activity: Combustion of fuel oil for heating
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report (Figure 6). WA EIA consumption scaled by population x EPA EF Hub factors.

activity: Gasoline/diesel combustion in on-road vehicles (in-boundary + transboundary)
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3 (matches Fehr & Peers VMT Study). Down 8% vs 2019; reduction driven by shorter trip lengths and EV uptake, not fewer trips. 24% of communitywide 2023.

activity: Air travel allocated to LFP residents
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. SeaTac jet-A fuel allocated by passenger survey + population + median household income. Largest single source — 30% of communitywide 2023. BASIC+ Scope 3.
Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. EPA MOVES model scaled by population. 7% of communitywide 2023. BASIC+.

activity: Generation and disposal of landfilled waste
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. King County waste characterization x EPA WARM. Exported waste = Scope 3. 77% of solid waste sector; reduce landfilled waste is a recommended policy lever.

activity: Generation and disposal of composted waste
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. EPA WARM factors. 23% of solid waste sector. GPC biological treatment.

activity: Fugitive refrigerant leakage from cooling equipment
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. EPA national GHG inventory scaled by population. High-GWP HFCs from AC and refrigeration. 8% of communitywide 2023. BASIC+.

activity: Emissions from tree canopy loss / land conversion
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3 (Land Use / Tree Loss). ICLEI LEARN tool, 2019-2021 average. Tree canopy SEQUESTRATION of -5550 MTCO2e reported separately as a sink — see Canopy view & canopy_afolu.csv. <1% of communitywide 2023.
